_comment: Written by ml/restroom/export_match.py. For every IOAI catalogue sign as a whole-sign Match query: the sign each model picks from the sign's gallery (its true partner plus up to 58 signs of its IOAI set). accuracy: share of queries per set whose pick is the true partner.
